product_one_liner.value: Wellinks combines virtual chronic-care management and remote patient monitoring to help health plans, providers, and health systems extend COPD care beyond the clinic.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage says Wellinks combines virtual chronic-care management with remote patient monitoring and directs the offering to payers and providers; its population-care description identifies health plans, providers, and health systems.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage footer lists its solution, audiences, resources, company, and legal links without a pricing link; the contact page instead invites organizations to inquire about partnering or offering Wellinks as a benefit.

value: Highmark Blue Cross Blue Shield Delaware
named_customers.notes: named_customers: The UMass Memorial item describes integration of Wellinks' care program across the system for its patients; the Highmark agreement makes Wellinks COPD care available to Highmark members. These show organizational deployment, rather than merely naming investors. | named_customers.0: The company says its virtual pulmonary rehabilitation program is integrated at UMass Memorial Health and available to the system's patients. | named_customers.1: The company says it agreed with Highmark Blue Cross Blue Shield Delaware to deliver COPD care to members, who can access Wellinks services.

employee_band.notes: The company profile was updated October 30, 2026 and reports 27 current employees, which falls in the 21-50 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile lists New Haven, Connecticut as the locality/headquarters location. | hq_country: The Wellinks LinkedIn profile identifies the country as United States and its locality as New Haven, Connecticut.

founded_year.notes: The Wellinks acquisition announcement states that the company was founded in 2012.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index labels the hub as news, research, and tips and lists company/product, patient activation, clinical-study, and care-outcome posts; it does not show at least two engineer-authored posts explaining product architecture, infrastructure, or implementation.

public_docs.notes: Wellinks has multiple public help articles, including a Bluetooth troubleshooting guide, spirometry instructions, and an app Action Plan guide, satisfying the several-articles requirement.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live careers board lists one opening, Senior Data and BI Analyst; data/BI analyst is expressly excluded from the AI/ML role definition, and no qualifying role is listed.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Wellinks footer badge identifies SOC 2; its official HIPAA privacy notice names HIPAA. HIPAA is included because the requested list explicitly treats it as a compliance item. | compliance_certs.0: The Wellinks footer badge identifies SOC 2. | compliance_certs.1: The official Wellinks privacy page is titled and labels its notice as HIPAA privacy practices.

This is the latest round found; third-party records conflict on the round label, so the company announcement is used. | funding_date: The official funding announcement dates the $10 million Series B first close to August 4, 2026, represented as 2026-08. | funding_amount_usd: Wellinks' announcement reports the first close of its Series B at $10 million on August 4, 2026. This is the latest disclosed round found; a third-party funding page labels the same date differently, so the company announcement is preferred and confidence is medium.

raised_18mo.notes: The company announced a $10 million Series B first close on August 4, 2026, within the 18 months preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live careers board lists only Senior Data and BI Analyst, not an SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest launch-type feature announcement located is the Action Plan feature, dated May 1, 2026, which is before the six-month window beginning May 9, 2026. The newer September 2026 news-index item is a leadership announcement, not a product launch; no later qualifying launch was found.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The dated August 31, 2026 announcement identifies new Wellinks VP appointments, including VP of Customer Success, VP of Clinical Operations, and VP of Technology, within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The current job board has one readable posting and the public product help articles are readable; the posting names analytics tools such as SQL/dbt and Power BI, but none of these inspected job/docs pages names a CRM or sales/marketing system.
